hero.subtitle: About Us
hero.title: Handmade Press-On Nails
hero.description: Silver14 Nail is a handmade press-on nail brand founded in Vietnam for people who love unique nail art, fashion, and personal style.

paragraphs.1: Every nail set is carefully handmade by skilled nail artists using salon-quality materials, combining modern trends with attention to detail.
paragraphs.2: From soft feminine styles to bold cyber and Y2K aesthetics, we aim to create artistic and reusable press-on nails.
paragraphs.3: Our shop offers a variety of styles including cute nails, chrome nails, cat eye effects, seasonal collections, and custom designs based on customer preferences.
paragraphs.4: Silver14 Nail press-on nails are lightweight, comfortable to wear, and reusable multiple times.
paragraphs.5: Each set is carefully crafted and packaged for customers all around the world. Thank you for supporting Silver14 Nail.
